theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

top_news.title: MercadoLibre Drops as E-Commerce Giant Signals More Spending
top_news.summary: MercadoLibre Inc. shares slid in late trading as analysts worried about the e-commerce giant’s spending plans despite it reporting sales and profits that beat consensus estimates in the second quarter.

top_news.title: Avocados at Risk as US Halts Government Work in Michoacán
top_news.summary: The US suspended government activities in the Mexican state of Michoacán, affecting imports of avocados from the largest producing region in the country to the US.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Set for Declines as AI Rally Cools: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks in Asia were poised to ease Thursday as investors digested gains in technology shares while watching for fresh signs of progress toward a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Tech Trade May See Bigger Retail Influence After July Rout, JPMorgan Says
top_news.summary: The technology trade may be poised to become even more dependent on retail investors and more volatile after a rough July, according to an assessment of preliminary data on technology, media and telecommunications equity sector hedge funds from JPMorgan Chase & Co.

top_news.title: S&P 500 Edges Lower After $3.7 Trillion Advance: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Wall Street’s blistering run took a breather, with traders digesting the recent stock gains and monitoring any hints of progress toward a deal to revive the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Hedge Funds Take Big Hit in July After Bruising AI Selloff
top_news.summary: A spate of well-known hedge funds reported steep losses in July as AI shares tumbled, most notably forcing the highly leveraged Situational Awareness to sell most of its stock portfolio at a deep discount to Ken Griffin’s Citadel.

top_news.title: Fed's Cook 'Prepared to Act' on Rates If Inflation Doesn't Slow
top_news.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook cautions that the longer inflation remains above the central bank’s goal, the tougher the job will be to rein it in during remarks at an event in Alaska.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Carry Trade Is Powering On as Investors Sidestep Yen’s Gains
top_news.summary: Emerging-market carry trades, some of this year’s most popular foreign-exchange bets, are showing resilience even after joint US-Japan currency intervention dented the appeal of this yen-funded strategy.

top_news.title: Celestica’s $3 Billion Deal Joins Data Center Funding Rush
top_news.summary: Celestica Inc. is looking to raise $3 billion from selling new shares, joining a flurry of companies raising funds for data centers to power the artificial intelligence buildout.

top_news.title: CME, FanDuel Venture Falters as Prediction Startups Race Ahead
top_news.summary: CME Group Inc. and FanDuel are scaling back a joint effort to take on prediction market startups after failing to gain traction in a booming industry that has quickly come to represent a threat to both Wall Street exchanges and traditional sportsbooks.
